proposal.purpose: Test whether removing first-order approximation improves complete small-update descriptions on separate probes. A fixed functional profiling method with extra base-model/calibration access; not a learned LoRAcle checkpoint.
proposal.data: Exact original272training+72development native snapshots, no new optimizer updates, no reserved or fresh cases. Same8 frozen training calibration prompts/values and32 answer patterns asv4.
proposal.prediction: Load the exact native update into the pinned base; score all8x32 calibration reference answers with original EOS and per-document mean completion CE; subtract exact zero-B baseline, average8 and center negative changes. Same stable argmax and .02span no_change. No fitted scale or hyperparameter search.
proposal.control: Same deterministic donor derangement asv4. To match recipient physical update norm, scale donorB by recipient_norm/donor_norm with donorA unchanged, then SCORE this actual scaled adapter. Do not scale an already-nonlinear profile. Zero controls remain exactzero.
proposal.precision: BF16 pinned base, FP32native adapters, FP64aggregation of FP32CE, chunk4; no TF32.
proposal.invariance: All280 native modules/560tensors restored after every own or shuffled case; baseversion counters unchanged; exact repeated baseline scores. No merging or modifying stored native snapshots.
proposal.audit: Complete dead controller, frozen sources/input/native/output hashes and original deadline; all688 own+shuffled score records; recompute all means/profiles/categories/controlscales; two fixed first-train/first-development own+shuffled scoring rechecks, exact restores.
proposal.analysis: Same64actual/8control development grid, all baselines and unchanged full-category gates. All344 profiles retained, including training. Compare linear-calibration vs exact-calibration vs measured-evaluation profiles; error decomposition is descriptive algebra, not causal attribution. Original2000 paired composition/initialization bootstrap.
proposal.criteria: Unchanged70%complete category,20ppreleased advantage,80%effectcoverage,90%zeros,10ppmajority and shuffled advantages. No source-task substitution, axis-only rescue, margin filtering or threshold changes.
proposal.release: No active output reading; normalcomplete+dead plus fullaudit. No automatic retries/resume.
proposal.future: Only if all development gates pass, freeze this new exact functional method and unchanged reserved+fresh grids before any test outcomes. An improved LoRAcle checkpoint cannot be claimed from functional profiling alone.
